payload.core_mechanism_summary: Prefix sums convert interior sum to zero condition into equality of prefix sums; for each letter, a hash map stores counts of prefix sums after that letter; answer increments by querying map for current prefix sum.
payload.rationale: The code explicitly uses dictionaries (hash maps) per character to store prefix sum counts and query matches in O(1), with no DP recurrence or two-pointer amortization. It directly implements subarray sum counting via prefix sums and hash map.
